$comment: Input of scripts/create-licenses.sh: for every package of the SBOM (doc/sbom.spdx.json) its copyright notice and where its licence texts are. Keys are the SPDX IDs of the packages without 'SPDXRef-'; a key may contain '*' as a wildcard. Licence text sources: 'vcpkg' (the port's share/<port>/copyright file installed by vcpkg), 'file:<path relative to the repository>' or 'spdx:<LicenseRef-...>' (the extracted licence text in the SBOM). 'source' replaces the SBOM's downloadLocation as source code location; 'note' is shown with the package. See doc/thirdparty.md (section Licence information).
